title: Shellbust
problem: The damage is 150% of the planned Defense loss from the stat calculator, not of the amount actually reduced. When the loss is blocked (Warded, Inertia, Giran's Rigor, Starwrath ...), redirected (Reflection), turned into a gain (Hallucination), cut, boosted, or clamped at the minimum stat, the damage still uses the planned amount. Also part of the fixed-amount family: the damage skips the spell-damage calculator, so the Damage Increased (Moonstone) property the Enchanter offers on it does nothing; the target's Defense isn't subtracted (text silent, hidden).
notes: Text: Target loses a moderate amount of {STAT_defense} and takes damage equal to 150% of the amount reduced. Evidence: bc_CreatureCast L9419 bc_SpellStat @0x1408ae146 (planned amount); L9420 bc_EventLoseDefense @0x1408ae52f -> scr_AddEventToStack @0x1408ae5be (queued; blocks/reductions in the builder, EFFECT_ORDER 'Stat loss'); L9432 amount x 1.5 (0x1498e5fc0 @0x1408aea50, big_mult @0x1408aeb58) -> bc_EventDamage @0x1408aedbc. Fix sketch: C hook: wrap bc_EventLoseDefense @0x1408ae52f to record the returned event's final amount (0 when it returns undefined / the loss was dropped); redirect the big_mult @0x1408aeb58 to a hook that uses that recorded amount x 1.5. This covers prevention, reflection, conversion and the builder's cuts/boosts; the minimum-stat clamp at landing would need the damage computed at execution time (a queued-event hook) if exactness there matters. For the Moonstone half see the family note in B3#14/#26. Reasoning: The text ties the damage to 'the amount reduced'; the code ties it to a number computed before any prevention or adjustment runs. They differ whenever the loss is changed, which is common, so this is a code bug. App note (unpatched game): Shellbust's damage is 150% of the planned Defense loss even if the loss is blocked or reduced, and spell-damage bonuses don't apply to it. Source: errata round 2 (2026-10-26). | Patch (batch L): bc_CreatureCast L9420 bc_EventLoseDefense @0x1408ae52f and L9432 big_mult @0x1408aeb58 go to hooks. Per target k ([rsp+0x2fd80], keyed by the frame) the first records the built event's final amount: 0 when the builder returns -1 (prevented, or Hallucination's conversion) or when the event's creature is not the target (Reflection), else event.amount. The second uses that amount x 1.5. Partial: the minimum-Defense clamp at landing is not seen (the damage can exceed the loss when the target is near its minimum), and the Damage Increased (Moonstone) half of the fixed-amount family is not addressed. A fully blocked loss now queues a 0 damage hit.

release_notes.intended: The target loses a moderate amount of Defense and takes damage equal to 150% of the amount reduced.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, the damage was 150% of the planned Defense loss, even when the loss was blocked, reflected back, turned into a gain, cut or boosted.
release_notes.fix: Now the damage is 150% of the Defense loss the target is actually dealt (0 when it is blocked, reflected or turned into a gain).
